title: PVL: Endgame errors continue to haunt Creamline, admits Pons

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Bernadeth Pons admitted that the root of Creamline’s woes lies in its errors at crucial points in its three straight losses in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Pons gave her all with 18 points, 15 digs and 14 excellent receptions, but Creamline still couldn’t secure a semifinals berth just yet after suffering its first-ever loss to unbeaten Nxled, 25-20, 12-25, 25-21, 25-19, on Tuesday night at Philsports Arena.
